Bihar Weather Update : bihar men mausam ka mijaj dhire-dhire badalne laga hai. subah aur sham ke vakt halki thand ka ehsas hone laga hai, jabki dophar men dhup nikalne se logon ko rahat mil rahi hai. mausam vibhag ke anusar, aaj bihar ke sabhi jilon men mausam shushk rahne ka anuman hai. philhal barish ki koee sanbhavna nahin hai. aise men saval hai ki aane vale dinon men thand kitni barhegi aur kya tapman men aur giravat dekhne ko milegi? janie bihar ke mausam ka taja hal aur aane vale dinon ka pura apdeta.
